note: Corps of Engineers campground on an open lawn on the south bank of the White River arm of Bull Shoals Lake at Forsyth, a mile below Powersite Dam: paved back-in sites with almost no shade, thirteen of them (13, 14, 17, 18 and 20 to 28) in a row along the riprap bank facing the water. The bottom floods when the lake is high. --Claude
summary: Closed for the season in the ordinary way (May 1 to September 29); recreation.gov has all 32 sites Open in status and selling from May 1, 2027, with no closure or flood notice. 32 sites with water and 30A or 50A, $24-26 as stored, 14-night limit. Riverfront confirmed by a site count: 13 of 32 on the bank. Season written. Phone found.
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED (stored riverfront - stands): recreation.gov's per-site coordinates on leaf-off imagery. The campground is a mown lawn with only scattered trees. Sites 13, 14, 17, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 28 - 13 of 32 - sit in a row between the loop road and the riprap bank, their pads about 10-30 m from the water with open grass and nothing else between (no road, trail or day use). Sites 11, 12, 15, 16 and 19 are across the loop road from them, 45-70 m from the water with an unobstructed view over the front row; sites 1-10 are in a block 130-180 m back; 29-32 are 60-100 m back at the west end. The water is the river-like upper end of Bull Shoals Lake, about 150 m wide here, a mile below Powersite Dam (so the Taneycomo pool above the dam plays no part).

FLOOD / STATUS: no flood, closure or damage notice is on the recreation.gov record; all 32 sites have status Open and the calendar sells May 2027. Whether the park opened late or closed early for high water in 2026 I could not read (the Corps' Bull Shoals pages were not fetched). The low-lying setting is noted in the note without a date.
SEASON (none stored): May 1 to September 29 from the rate table (same dates in 2026, 2027, 2028) and the calendar. Written.

ELECTRIC: stored 50; the rate table sells two classes, 30A with water ($24) and 50A with water ($26). The catalog does not say which sites are which (no Electricity Hookup attribute on any record). 50 kept as the highest available.
SEWER: not stored, written null - nothing read says either way; no dump station is listed in the amenities either.

PIN: stored 36.6800,-93.1016 is recreation.gov's point at the park entrance off the Highway 76 bridge approach; the sites' centroid is 36.68097,-93.10375, about 220 m west-north-west. Under the 250 m threshold; no move proposed, but the riverfront row's midpoint is 36.6814,-93.1044 if a pin on the sites is wanted.
PHONE: none stored. recreation.gov: (417) 546-3646 for the park; (870) 425-2700 (Mountain Home project office) 'for facility specific information'.
UNREAD: the Corps' Bull Shoals Lake pages (swl.usace.army.mil) were not fetched; everything is from recreation.gov and imagery.
